in_sanskrit.name: मान्या
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: प्रशन्नता, मानवता, सहायता (prashannaata, manavata, sahaayata) = प्रशस्ति (prashasti) या विशेष रूप के साथ उपयोग किया जाता है (used in a special sense as prashasti)

in_marathi.name: Maanya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Desire, Ambition, Pride
in_marathi.long_meaning: Maanya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Maanya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'mana' meaning 'mind' or 'thought'. It signifies one's pride, desire, or ambition. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Mahalakshmi is often associated with the quality of maanya, representing the goddess of wealth and prosperity.
